FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Haven Market
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Fresh Haven Market operates as a full-service grocery store serving the Springfield community. We specialize in a diverse selection of fresh produce, meats, dairy products, and pantry staples, ensuring that our customers have access to quality food items at competitive prices. Our business spans over 3,000 square feet, providing ample space for a wide range of products. We prioritize food safety and compliance with all local and federal regulations, conducting regular employee training and maintaining documented health and safety procedures.

Our store features a well-organized layout that enhances customer shopping experience, and we implement strict pest control and sanitation procedures to ensure a clean environment. We manage our inventory using modern systems, focusing on minimizing shrinkage and ensuring quality control. Additionally, we have established relationships with reputable vendors who adhere to food safety and quality standards.

Fresh Haven Market operates with a strong commitment to community engagement, participating in local events and promotions. Our dedicated staff is trained in emergency preparedness, ensuring that we are ready to respond effectively to any incidents. We focus on our core grocery business to maintain safety for both our customers and employees.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, Fresh Haven Market experienced a water damage incident due to a malfunctioning refrigeration unit, resulting in a loss amount of $7,500. The claim is currently under review, pending approval from the insurance adjuster. On 06/10/2023, an employee accidentally spilled cleaning chemicals, causing temporary closure of an aisle and a loss of $3,000. This incident has been resolved and the area was sanitized. Additionally, on 07/25/2023, a theft occurred involving approximately $4,500 in products. The incident is reported to the police and the security footage is being evaluated.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Sunday, 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class III, UL Listed Commercial Safe, Group II.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Installing a security fence around the premises and employing two watchpersons during operating hours to enhance safety and deter theft.

Our focus is solely on providing grocery products without the involvement of any hazardous operations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Fresh Haven Market does not sponsor any athletic teams, as our focus is primarily on providing quality grocery products and engaging with the local community through different initiatives.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The responsibility for checking these certificates typically lies with the store management or designated personnel.

The business maintains a strong commitment to ethical operations and compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Haven Market has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior three years. The business maintains compliance with all necessary regulations and safety standards.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Haven Market does not lease employees to or from other employers, focusing solely on our in-house staff to maintain operational consistency and service quality.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Fresh Haven Market carries Workers' Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements and to ensure the safety and protection of its employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Fresh Haven Market does not own or operate any other business, focusing exclusively on its grocery store operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Haven Market does not currently hold any other insurance policies with this company. The only active policy is specifically for grocery store liability coverage.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Haven Market does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The focus is solely on retailing a diverse selection of grocery items without additional processing.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Haven Market does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on providing grocery products to the community. This approach ensures that we maintain full control over our operations and risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Haven Market has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial status.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Haven Market does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as we focus solely on grocery retail without engaging in hazardous operations. Our operations prioritize safety and compliance with all relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Haven Market does not have any catastrophe exposure as we focus on grocery retail operations without engaging in hazardous situations or activities that could lead to catastrophic incidents.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Haven Market has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business is committed to maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for both employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Haven Market has no uncorrected fire code violations and adheres to all necessary fire safety regulations. The business prioritizes compliance and maintains a safe environment for customers and employees.
